title: clio-coder run event line (schema v2)
description: One line of `run --output-format stream-json`: NDJSON, one compact object per line, each with a `type`. The first line is `session` for a main run, `steer` acknowledges a steer-channel line, and the last line is always `run_end` (schema run-result). Agent event frames between them keep their engine shape and are open objects.

line.description: 1-based line index in the steer channel.

runEnd.description: The closing document; its full shape is `clio-coder schema run-result`.

event.description: An engine event frame. A field that names a tool call (`toolCallId` on tool_execution_* and tool_approval_state frames and on a toolResult message, `parentToolCallId` on a gateway chain step) holds Clio's id `tc_<turn>_<n>`: the n-th call (1-based) the model's message lists in the run's turn-th agent turn (1-based, counted from turn_start). A chain step's id is `<parent's Clio id>:<step id>`. The provider's id rides beside it as `providerToolCallId`; for a chain step, the provider's id of the call that ran the chain. A toolCall block inside a message keeps the provider's `id`.
